pages.title: US 26% tariff hits AP seafood exports

facts.text: What: US President Donald Trump announced 26% tariff on aqua products — AP shipments to US halted within 24 hours
facts.head: News

facts.text: Total duties: up to 34% (tariff + anti-dumping + countervailing)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Shrimp price: 100 count fell from ₹235/kg to ₹195/kg
facts.head: News

facts.text: Item: AP aqua employment; Figure: ~50 lakh
facts.head: India's seafood exports, 2023–24

facts.text: What: US paused the 26% levy for 90 days — AP exports to US back to normal (per SEAI, AP unit)
facts.head: Recovery after 90-day pause

facts.text: Loss during halt: unconfirmed over ₹1,000 crore
facts.head: Recovery after 90-day pause

facts.text: Revived districts: Eluru, Krishna, East and West Godavari, Nellore, Prakasam
facts.head: Recovery after 90-day pause

facts.text: Demand: call for an FTA with the US
facts.head: Recovery after 90-day pause
